findings.nonzero_nodes: Engine._launch_subprocesses on node_rank>=1 starts only dummy health/metrics listener then blocks; node35/41 are not profile HTTP entrypoints.
findings.fan_out: Tokenizer profile FanOutCommunicator initialized with dp_size, waits for that many responses; DPcontroller routes ProfileReq to allworkers; requestreceiver broadcasts control across TP as configured. One rank0 control call perP/Drole is intended to reach all32roleworkers.
findings.start_ack: Scheduler immediately routes ProfileReq to manager._profile and sends its returned ProfileReqOutput to tokenizer. With no start_step, _profile calls _init_profile then _start_profile immediately. num_steps8 sets target currentforward+9 and does not defer ACK until capture completion.
findings.partial_failure: Tokenizer _execute_profile inspects only first collected success. ReturnedHTTP200 is not per-rank proof; actual native trace/stop coverage required. Inactive SGstop returnsfailure; never duplicate configure/start blindly.
findings.runtime_validation_pending: No control API called. Futureprofile must use rank0 only, boundsteps, verify allroleworker artifacts/stop, preserve rawtraces and archive onlyowncompletedprofile files away from liveprofile root before any later unprofiled baseline.
